about: Ezekiel was a prophet who saw amazing visions about God's glory and His power to bring new life.

pages.title: The Good Shepherd
pages.scene: A shepherd carrying a hurt lamb
pages.text: God said, "My sheep are lost and scattered. I myself will look for them. I will bring them home, feed them in green fields and take care of the hurt ones. I will be their shepherd."
pages.lesson: God looks for us and takes care of us.

pages.title: Dry Bones Live
pages.scene: A valley of dry bones coming together
pages.text: God showed Ezekiel a valley full of dry bones. God said, "Tell the bones to listen!" The bones came together, and God's breath made them alive! They stood up like a big army. God can give new life to anything.
